To make a frame close when the user presses the ESC (Escape) key, add its name to the UISpecialFrames table: tinsert(UISpecialFrames, frame:GetName()) Note that in order for this to work, your frame must have a name and be registered in the global variable list.

A macro is a list of slash commands. Common slash commands include the following: * /say (/s) * /whisper (/w, /talk, /t) * /reply (/r) * /emote (/e, /em, /me) * /dance With macros, these commands can be used from action buttons, and many of them can be used at once. Each unique command goes on its own line and is written exactly as it would be typed it in the chat box. For instance, a macro that makes the player yell "Everybody, dance now!" and burst into dance would be written thus. /y Everybody, dance now! /dance A mostly complete list of slash commands is available at Macro API. Malden's Orchard is a small orchard in northern Silverpine Forest. The trees in the orchard are dark and evergreen, but their fruits have not been picked in years. The orchard is named for its former owner, who was forced to flee his home when the Scourge invaded Lordaeron. Recently, large numbers of black worgs have taken up residence around the orchard and its single small cottage. When the Deathstalkers Rane Yorick, Quinn Yorick, and Erland McKree were conducting their reconnaissance mission, Erland was tasked with exploring Malden's Orchard. The Maker's Rise is an elevator in the Halls of Origination. The bottom floor of this room is some kind of balcony overlooking a core of some kind, meant for players that fall through the elevator's shaft. The first floor connects the Vault of Lights, the Chamber of Prophecy, and the Tomb of the Earthrager. The second floor connects the four seats of the guardians of the facility. The third floor contains a room like the Tribunal of Ages (with four heads: three male, one female, with only the female one speaking) where an override for the reorgination device can be found.

Mak'gora (also written as mak'gora or Mak'Gora), meaning "duel of honor", is an orcish custom whereby someone may challenge another person to individual combat. The ritualistic duel has been often used to obtain a position of leadership, such as a fight for the position of group leader, clan chieftain, or Warchief of the Horde, but not necessarily. Mak'gora is practiced by ogre clans as well.

The Mak'Rogahn (or "duel of will") is an orcish Warsong clan's custom whereby someone may challenge another to prove his worth. The contenders fight in the pit until one of them is unable to continue. It is a pure display of will to survive any hardship and endure all pain. If one of the contenders surrenders, he is excommunicated from the clan. If neither surrenders, both are honored—the victor for winning and the loser for the will to fight to the end. Unlike Mak'gora it is not supposed to be a fight to the death, but accidents happen. Mak'Rogahn was employed by Grommash to cull the shame from the day when an ogre raid nearly wiped out the clan.

Makusha is the mother of the tuskarr Taruka and Unka, left to care for them after their father died at sea. The night before their clan began their journey to Kamagua, the three had a dinner which, as often happened, was not a happy occasion. Unka sulked because Taruka hadn't earned enough knots to buy kite silk for her, and Makusha barely ate before she resumed working on an undershirt, a surer but slower and less respected way of earning knots. Makusha had taught Taruka to sew, and together they could've finished the shirt faster. Malevolent Felslate is mined from Malevolent Felslate Outcroppings in Suramar.

Malyfous Darkhammer is a Dark Iron dwarf quest giver located in Everlook in Winterspring. He originally crafted three items for you via quests: Breastplate of Bloodthirst, Leggings of Arcana, and Cap of the Scarlet Savant. When The Beast in Upper Blackrock Spire was killed and skinned, Pip Quickwit appeared. He offered a quest that could be turned in to Malyfous to allow you to take these quests from a catalogue on a barrel next to him.
Malice is a Rogue talent located in the 1st tier of the Assassination Tree. It increases the rogue's critical strike chance.

Malton Droffers is an orc quest giver located in the Drag in Orgrimmar. He is the son of Dran Droffers and runs the salvage business with him. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen in front of the building speaking with an Orgrimmar Grunt. He appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar wielding a tire.
__NOTOC__ Malorne Bladeleaf is a night elf artisan herbalism trainer located in Dolanaar in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
__NOTOC__ The Mallet of Zul'Farrak was once needed for players to summon Gahz'rilla, a boss in Zul'Farrak.
Malice Stone Pendant is necklace with Intellect, Spirit, spell damage and spell penetration, which is generally good for casters, like Mages and Warlocks.
The Malicious Axe is a two-handed axe with high stamina bonus.
Malux is a jungle troll artisan skinning trainer located in Shadowprey Village in Desolace.
Mallen Swain is a Forsaken tailoring vendor located in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Mama Wheeler is a goblin quest giver located at Midrealm Post in the Netherstorm. She is the wife of Papa Wheeler who is stationed at Area 52.
__NOTOC__ The Malfunctioning Reaver is a rare golem in Burning Steppes.
Malignant Footguards are epic mail boots that are excellent for shamans.
Malleable Chain Leggings are a quest reward from Apprentice's Duties.
Mallet of the Tides is an epic one-handed mace, especially good for tanking.
Malfurion's Signet Ring is a quest reward from Waking Legends.
Malgen's Long Bow is a Level 51 quality Bow that improves Agility, Stamina and Critical Strike.
Maltendis' Handguards are a quest reward from Troll Juju (quest).
Malfas the Purple Netherwing Drake is one of the six Netherwing reward quests players may choose from.
Malicia is a dracthyr located in the Gladiator's Refuge in Valdrakken. She sells equipment and consumables in return for Bloody Tokens. She is also the host of the Nokhudon Proving Grounds.
Malukaz can be found in Stonebreaker Hold, Terokkar Forest. He aims to bring the wolf spirit back to Stonebreaker Hold.

Malyfous's Catalogue is a book sitting on a barrel next to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook, Winterspring. In order to view the contents of the book, adventurers must complete the quest Pip Quickwit, At Your Service!. This quest starts with Pip Quickwit who appears after The Beast is defeated in Upper Blackrock Spire. The Catalogue gives three quests which list the ingredients for three epic items that Malyfous can craft for you: *Breastplate of Bloodthirst (quest) *Cap of the Scarlet Savant (quest) *Leggings of Arcana (quest) All three items require a which can only be skinned from The Beast by a skinner with at least 310 skill.

Malor's Strongbox can be found in Scarlet side Stratholme, by Willey Hopebreaker. It formerly contained the Medallion of Faith which was a quest objective for The Medallion of Faith. It now only contains a small amount of gold.

Malkorix is a Blizzard employee who frequently used to post on the US World of Warcraft [http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/board.html?sid=1&forumId=11112 Customer Service Forum]. Malkorix was famous for devouring "Warm Fuzzies." He also enjoyed Red Bull and "catalocking". He swears up and down that he is off the nip, but posters in the CSF still offer it to him. He denies ever taking catnip and refuses to have any, but some CSF'ers have seen him sniff it. He worked out of the Irvine, California office. On July 18th, 2010, Auryk confirmed that both he and Syndri have moved on to other opportunities within Blizzard Entertainment. He made his last post as a Customer Service Forum representative
__NOTOC__ Malevolent Hatchlings are kaliri released from Cursed Eggs in Veil Lithic of Terokkar Forest.
Mammoth Cutters were crafted with Engineering (410); taught by trainers. This item is created 1000 at a time.

Malithas Brightblade is a Horde retribution paladin and is one of the possible opponents for Alliance in the Faction Champions battle in the Trial of the Crusader raid instance. He can also be found alongside several other Horde champions at the Sunreaver Pavilion.
__NOTOC__ Mammoth Calves are younger mammoths found in the Borean Tundra.
Malfus Grimfrost is a human and can be found at Light's Hammer in Icecrown Citadel. He sells the Tier 10 armor for mages.

Malicia's Outpost is a new area just south of the Weeping Cave in the Western Plaguelands. The area appears to be inhabited by members of the Cult of the Damned who have various animals imprisoned in cages, led by Malicia herself.
Malfurion's Vision is an interlude in the Terror of the Tides campaign, following after chapter six, Shards of the Alliance.

Maloriak is a boss in Blackwing Descent who can be found in the Fleshrender's Workshop, off to the east of the Vault of the Shadowflame. Killing him awards the title Slayer of Stupid, Incompetent and Disappointing Minions which lasts for 30 minutes.
Malformed Ooze are oozelings spawned during the boss encounter with Sjonnir The Ironshaper in the Halls of Stone instance. When two Malformed Oozes come together, they form an Iron Sludge.
Mammoth Harness is provided as an objective for A Mammoth Undertaking.
This breadcrumb quest points to the quest chain involving the Eye of the Vortex.

Mama Celeste is an individual of uncertain background who currently resides in the farmhouse of Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. In these desperate times, she is cooking Westfall Mud Pies and will solicit help gathering "fresh dirt" and coyote tails. She was present during the Legion Invasions.

__NOTOC__ The Malformed Defias Drone was an undead guarding Klaven Mortwake's tower in Westfall. The two Defias patrollers Jill and Raven feared ending up as drones if they slacked in their guard duties. He was previously an agent sent by Master Mathias Shaw to kill Mortwake, raised back in undeath through the use of a Zanzil poison brought by the Venture Company.
Malmortis is Drakuru's servant. He is summoned from his Musty Coffin during Disclosure, and guides the player through the Warlord's private room.
Malicious Instructors are shivarra found in the Shadow Labyrinth instructing the Cabal Shadow Priests and Cabal Acolytes

__NOTOC__ Mamdy the "Ologist" is an ethereal quest giver located inside the entrance of the Mana-Tombs in Auchindoun. He was originally found in Terokkar Forest. He and Artificer Morphalius are the only two ethereals so far who have passed through Nexus-Prince Shaffar's ward and lived.
Malignant Troggs are part of the General Umbriss encounter in Grim Batol.

Mama Stormstout is the (slightly senile) matriarch of the Stormstout family in Pandaria. She, along with Big Dan, Evie and Han Stormstout, ventured into the Dread Wastes to help thwart the sha-corrupted mantid swarm plaguing Pandaria. She was trapped inside the Amber Hibernal with Iyyokuk the Lucid until she and the paragon were freed by the player and Chen Stormstout. She, along with the surviving members of the Stormstouts, left the Dread Wastes and sold their brews at the Timeless Isle. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, she traveled to the Wandering Isle and was seen in the Laughing Crane. During the Assault in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, she was located in the Vale of Eternal

:"Heroes never die." Malik the Unscathed is a mantid paragon found in the Dread Wastes. First found and awakened in the Clutches of Shek'zeer he proceeds to Klaxxi'vess to aid the Klaxxi. During the quest The Empress' Gambit, Imperial Vizier Zor'lok kills Malik. Should players still need his enhancement, the Halberd of the Unscathed can be found on the weapon rack in Klaxxi'vess.
Malted Cave Barley is found inside the Dark Hollow beneath the Valley of the Four Winds.
Malevolent Gladiator's Refuge is the Season 12 Restoration Druid arena set.
Malevolent Gladiator's Sanctuary is the Season 12 Feral Druid arena set.
Malevolent Gladiator's Wildhide is the Season 12 Balance Druid arena set.
